newsitem.title: USA: JLG sees Q3, possibly Q4 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: JLG sees Q3, possibly Q4 below expectations.

text.p: JLG Industries Inc said Monday that third quarter earnings should exceed last year's $0.28 per share but may not meet analysts' expectations, which it said are $0.33 to $0.36 per share.

The company attributed its projection to lower domestic rental fleet utilization rates by its customers, slower incoming domestic orders and a shift in product mix to smaller, less profitable machines.

Additionally, it said its fourth quarter results could be impacted by recent and expected interest rate increases, which it said may affect order patterns. It said fourth quarter results should exceed the $0.30 per share for the 1996 fourth quarter, but could fall short of analysts' expectations of $0.37 to $0.39 per share.
The company said the factors affecting its third and fourth quarters could be short-term in nature and that it expects to report its fourth consecutive year of record results.
